nphi.summary: FHI hosted European NPHIs on their role in health security preparedness, medical countermeasures and resilience amid funding shifts and misinformation.

nphi.title: PHAC–ECDC joint action plan
nphi.with: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC)
nphi.summary: During a February 2026 visit to Stockholm, PHAC and ECDC adopted their first joint operational action plan, covering preparedness, risk assessment, epidemic intelligence, surveillance and training, and explored joint outbreak…

nphi.title: Biosafety and biosecurity capacity building at Africa CDC
nphi.actor: Global Affairs Canada (Weapons Threat Reduction Program)
nphi.with: Africa CDC; African Society for Laboratory Medicine (ASLM, implementer)
nphi.summary: A CAD 7.5 million Canadian contribution (2025–2028), delivered by ASLM, to help Africa CDC develop and implement a continental biosafety and biosecurity strategic plan under Canada's Signature Initiative to Mitigate Biological Threats in…

nphi.title: North American Preparedness for Animal and Human Pandemics Initiative (NAPAHPI)
nphi.with: US HHS; Mexico Secretaría de Salud (plus agriculture, security and foreign affairs agencies)
nphi.summary: A trilateral One Health framework released in October 2024 for joint preparedness and response to animal and human pandemics. It replaces the 2007 and 2012 North American influenza plans.

nphi.title: Five-nation public health institute exchanges on data sharing, digitalisation and AI
nphi.with: US CDC; Australian CDC; Public Health Agency of Canada; New Zealand public health agency
nphi.summary: UKHSA held regular meetings in 2024/25 with the public health institutes of the US, Australia, Canada and New Zealand on data sharing, digitalisation and artificial intelligence.

nphi.title: Santé publique France – INSPQ partnership agreement
nphi.with: Institut national de santé publique du Québec (INSPQ)
nphi.summary: A long-standing series of collaboration agreements, renewed in 2023 with a new two-year action plan. They cover population health monitoring, prevention evaluation, health threats and emergencies, inequalities, biomonitoring and climate…

nphi.title: Health Security Partnership to Strengthen Disease Surveillance in Africa (HSPA)
nphi.with: Africa CDC; WHO (Hub for Pandemic and Epidemic Intelligence); Canada Weapons Threat Reduction Program; UK government
nphi.summary: WHO, Africa CDC and RKI link health and security sectors for collaborative surveillance (biorisk, event- and indicator-based and genomic surveillance, epidemic intelligence). Phase 1 covered six countries from 2023; phase 2 (2025-2028)…

nphi.title: Canada–Taiwan MoU on health cooperation
nphi.actor: Canadian Trade Office in Taipei (with PHAC)
nphi.with: Taiwan Ministry of Health and Welfare; Taipei Economic and Cultural Office in Canada; Public Health Agency of Canada (witness)
nphi.summary: Canada's and Taiwan's representative offices signed a health cooperation MoU in May 2023, witnessed by PHAC and Taiwan's Ministry of Health and Welfare. It covers international health security, digital health, mental health and NCDs,…

nphi.title: Mitigation of Biological Threats (MBT) in the ASEAN Region Program
nphi.actor: Global Affairs Canada (Weapons Threat Reduction Program)
nphi.with: ASEAN Secretariat; ASEAN EOC Network; ASEAN BioDiaspora Virtual Center; ACPHEED; PHAC (participant)
nphi.summary: A Canadian-funded ASEAN programme, running since 2014, that strengthens regional biosafety, biosecurity, surveillance and preparedness. It helped set up the ASEAN EOC Network and the BioDiaspora Virtual Center. Phase 3 (2024–2027) was…

nphi.title: CPHLN–APHL cross-border public health laboratory MoU
nphi.actor: Public Health Agency of Canada – National Microbiology Laboratory
nphi.with: Canadian Public Health Laboratory Network (CPHLN); Association of Public Health Laboratories (APHL)
nphi.summary: Long-running Canada–US agreement, first signed in 2004 and renewed in 2008, 2011 and 2018, linking provincial and state public health labs directly for information exchange, joint work and shared standards.

nphi.title: Global Health Security Initiative (GHSI)
nphi.with: Global Health Security Initiative (G7 + Mexico health ministries, European Commission; WHO observer)
nphi.summary: An informal partnership of the G7 countries, Mexico and the European Commission (with WHO as observer) on health security, launched at a ministerial meeting in Ottawa in 2001. Its working groups include a laboratory network, pandemic…

nphi.title: PulseNet Canada participation in PulseNet International
nphi.with: US CDC / PulseNet International
nphi.summary: PulseNet Canada, coordinated by PHAC's National Microbiology Laboratory since 2000, takes part in PulseNet International and shares whole-genome sequencing data in real time to detect and investigate foodborne outbreaks. Canada was among…

nphi.title: Global Public Health Intelligence Network (GPHIN) early-warning partnership with WHO
nphi.with: World Health Organization (WHO); Nuclear Threat Initiative (co-launch of GPHIN II)
nphi.summary: GPHIN, built by Health Canada with WHO and now run by PHAC, scans global media in several languages for signals of outbreaks and other public health threats, and feeds alerts to WHO and other international users.

nphi.title: Pasteur Network (Institut Pasteur International Network)
nphi.with: Pasteur Network members incl. Institut Pasteur de Dakar, de Bangui, de Côte d'Ivoire, de Guinée, du Maroc, de Madagascar, de Tunis, d'Algérie, du Cambodge, du Laos, Korea, Montevideo, São Paulo; Centre Pasteur du Cameroun; CERMES Niger; Fiocruz; NIHE, Pasteur Institutes Nha Trang and Ho Chi Minh City; Pasteur Institute of Iran; HKU-Pasteur Research Pole; Sciensano; Stephan Angeloff Institute; Hellenic Pasteur Institute; Institut Pasteur in Saint Petersburg
nphi.summary: Global network of about 33 public health and research institutes in 25 countries and territories, many of them national reference laboratories or NPHIs, collaborating on infectious disease surveillance, research and training.

nphi.title: HSPA phase II – public health intelligence trainings in Tunisia and Morocco (2026)
nphi.with: ONMNE Tunisia; DELM Morocco; WHO EMRO; WHO Hub; ECDC; Lebanese Ministry of Public Health
nphi.summary: RKI (ZIG1 leads the epidemic-intelligence work area) delivered PHI Foundations trainings with Tunisia's ONMNE (May 2026) and Morocco's DELM (July 2026), turning phase-I country roadmaps into practice, funded by Canada and the UK.

nphi.title: EPHI – Nutrition International strategic partnership MoU
nphi.with: Nutrition International (Research and Development unit)
nphi.summary: MoU signed in November 2025 formalising joint research, innovation and evaluation of nutrition and public health interventions, positioning EPHI as a regional centre of excellence.

nphi.title: Health-security partnership to strengthen disease surveillance and epidemic intelligence in Africa
nphi.actor: Global Affairs Canada (Weapons Threat Reduction Program)
nphi.with: Africa CDC; WHO; African Society for Laboratory Medicine (ASLM)
nphi.summary: A Canadian-funded project (2023–2024), delivered through ASLM, that supported WHO and Africa CDC on country partnerships, a regional bio-surveillance framework for high-risk pathogens, and early-warning and epidemic-intelligence training.

nphi.title: Gates-funded Integrated Disease Surveillance project
nphi.with: INS Mozambique; NIH Pakistan; others not named
nphi.summary: In 2022, IANPHI ran a Gates-funded study of integrated disease surveillance. It made country deep dives in Mozambique, Pakistan, Malawi, Uganda, England, Sweden and Canada, and held a webinar with NIH Pakistan and INS Mozambique.

nphi.title: IDRC-funded One Health epidemics project in Guinea and DRC
nphi.with: Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP, Guinea); Institut National de Recherche Biomédicale (INRB, DRC); CERFIG (Guinea); University of Ottawa
nphi.summary: IDRC awarded nearly CAD 5 million (2022) to a three-year project led by the University of Ottawa, with Guinea's INSP and DRC's INRB, to decentralize One Health platforms and strengthen surveillance and risk communication for emerging…

nphi.title: PHAC–CARPHA collaboration on COVID-19 critical care capacity (F-ACES course)
nphi.with: Caribbean Public Health Agency (CARPHA) and its Member States; Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada
nphi.summary: PHAC worked with CARPHA to strengthen Member States' COVID-19 response capacity through the Facilitated Acute Critical Events Simulation course, framed as strengthening regional health security.

nphi.title: Phase 3 'Ebola ça suffit' ring-vaccination trial of Canada's VSV-EBOV vaccine in Guinea
nphi.with: WHO; Guinea Ministry of Health; Norwegian Institute of Public Health (NIPH); MSF/Epicentre; IDRC; CIHR
nphi.summary: Canada (PHAC, IDRC, CIHR, DFATD) supported the WHO and Guinea Ministry of Health Phase 3 trial of the PHAC-developed VSV-EBOV Ebola vaccine. Canadian experts advised on safety monitoring and helped build Guinean research capacity.

nphi.title: Laboratory biorisk management training for Jordanian laboratory staff (Winnipeg)
nphi.with: Canadian Science Centre for Human and Animal Health (Winnipeg); International Centre for Infectious Diseases; Global Affairs Canada (funder)
nphi.summary: Global Affairs Canada funded biorisk management training at the Canadian Science Centre for Human and Animal Health in Winnipeg, which houses PHAC's NML, for five Jordanian staff who run Canadian-funded biological laboratories in Jordan.

nphi.title: Kenya–Canada peer-to-peer partnership
nphi.with: Kenya Ministry of Health (DPPHS); IANPHI
nphi.summary: PHAC hosted a study tour for Kenya's new Directorate of Preventive and Promotive Health Services on how a national public health agency is set up.

nphi.title: National Microbiology Laboratory collaborations on emerging pathogen detection in West Africa
nphi.with: Ministries of health and health authorities (not named); Global Affairs Canada
nphi.summary: PHAC's National Microbiology Laboratory trained Sierra Leonean scientists in specimen handling, supported Lassa fever diagnostics in Nigeria and ecological specimen testing in Mali, and supported the 2014–16 Ebola response in Guinea and…

nphi.title: PHAC epidemiologist deployment via GOARN to the Philippines (Typhoon Haiyan response)
nphi.with: Philippine Department of Health; WHO / GOARN
nphi.summary: PHAC, a founding GOARN member, sent an epidemiologist to the WHO-led response team in the Philippines in November 2013 to help the Department of Health with post-disaster disease surveillance and risk assessment.

nphi.title: NML mobile laboratory deployment for the 2012 Ebola outbreak in DRC
nphi.actor: Public Health Agency of Canada – National Microbiology Laboratory
nphi.with: World Health Organization (requesting agency)
nphi.summary: At WHO's request, the Winnipeg National Microbiology Laboratory deployed a mobile laboratory team to the DRC in 2012 to provide rapid on-site Ebola diagnostic testing.

nphi.title: Enhanced biological security and disease surveillance in the Caribbean (modular laboratory for CAREC)
nphi.with: Caribbean Epidemiology Centre (CAREC, now part of CARPHA)
nphi.summary: Canada's Global Partnership Program gave CAD 2.5 million (2012–2013) for a fully equipped modular laboratory at CAREC in Port of Spain, to improve rapid detection and response to natural or deliberate outbreaks in the Caribbean.

nphi.title: Canada–China Plan of Action on Cooperation in the field of health (Health Canada/PHAC)
nphi.with: Ministry of Health of the People's Republic of China; Health Canada
nphi.summary: Health Canada, PHAC and China's Ministry of Health agreed a 2011–2014 plan of action for health cooperation, following an earlier 2005–2008 plan that covered public health emergencies such as infectious disease outbreaks.

nphi.title: INS Mozambique postgraduate training and education partnerships
nphi.with: Institute of Tropical Medicine Antwerp (ITM); Instituto de Higiene e Medicina Tropical (IHMT-UNL), Lisbon; IDRC Canada; US CDC
nphi.summary: Mozambique's INS runs education and cooperation with ITM Antwerp and IHMT Lisbon, received IDRC funding for a master's in health systems (2015) and US CDC support for a field epidemiology and laboratory management master's (2010).

nphi.title: Canada–PAHO strategic cooperation agreement
nphi.with: Pan American Health Organization (PAHO); PHAC; CIDA; IDRC
nphi.summary: In 2010 Health Canada and PAHO signed an agreement for stronger joint action on emerging diseases, NCDs, health systems and Indigenous health. PHAC, CIDA, IDRC and Canadian WHO/PAHO collaborating centres take part through exchanges,…

nphi.title: NML laboratory testing support to Mexico during the 2009 H1N1 outbreak
nphi.with: Secretaría de Salud (Mexico); National Microbiology Laboratory (NML)
nphi.summary: At Mexico's request, PHAC's National Microbiology Laboratory tested about 200 respiratory specimens from Mexican patients in April 2009 and helped identify the new H1N1 virus. Canada later supplied Mexico with 5 million H1N1 vaccine doses.

nphi.title: PHAC/IDRC–INS Colombia chronic disease surveillance project in Pasto
nphi.with: Instituto Nacional de Salud (INS) Colombia; International Development Research Centre (IDRC, Canada)
nphi.summary: An IANPHI project in which Colombia's INS partnered with PHAC and Canada's IDRC on chronic disease surveillance and research in Pasto.

nphi.title: ECDC–PHAC memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Public Health Agency of Canada (PHAC)
nphi.summary: MoU signed in 2007 between ECDC and the Public Health Agency of Canada on cooperation in communicable disease control.

nphi.title: Trilateral North American MoU on mutual assistance in public health emergencies
nphi.with: US Department of Health and Human Services; Secretaría de Salud de México
nphi.summary: MoU signed in November 2007 committing Canada, the US and Mexico to mutual assistance in public health emergencies, cross-border surveillance cooperation, laboratory information and reagent sharing, joint exercises and sharing of…

nphi.title: International Infectious Disease Centre, Nairobi (NML contribution)
nphi.with: University of Nairobi; University of Manitoba; National Microbiology Laboratory (NML)
nphi.summary: PHAC's National Microbiology Laboratory gave expertise and equipment to the International Infectious Disease Centre in Nairobi, which opened in 2007 from the University of Manitoba–University of Nairobi partnership to support infectious…

nphi.title: Canada–Chile technical cooperation project on chronic disease policy
nphi.with: Chile Ministry of Health; PAHO/CARMEN; WHO CC on NCD Policy (PHAC)
nphi.summary: Through its WHO Collaborating Centre, PHAC ran a three-phase technical cooperation project (2007–2009) with Chile on chronic disease prevention policy, which was later extended to Paraguay and Brazil.

nphi.title: WHO Collaborating Centre on Chronic Noncommunicable Disease Policy (PHAC)
nphi.with: WHO HQ; PAHO (CARMEN network and CARMEN Policy Observatory)
nphi.summary: PHAC hosts the WHO Collaborating Centre on chronic NCD policy, first designated in 1994. Its work includes policy research, training, co-leading the CARMEN Policy Observatory with PAHO, and supporting WHO NCD networks.

nphi.title: Canada-Asia Regional Emerging Infectious Diseases (CAREID) project
nphi.with: Ministries of Health; National Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology (NIHE, Vietnam); Philippine Department of Health / San Lazaro Hospital; CIDA (funder)
nphi.summary: A CAD 4.3 million, CIDA-funded project led by PHAC that built capacity to detect and respond to emerging infectious diseases in Southeast Asia. PHAC ran its biosafety pillar, including biorisk management training and work with Vietnam's…
